candidates.statement: Inventory's redis reserve_inventory calls time out (~2s), returning 503 on /v1/reservations; order's call to inventory then ReadTimeouts, producing 502 on /v1/orders and /v1/checkout. Traces show redis timeout errors and inventory 503s; inventory metrics show 13.7 reserve_inventory ops and 3.6 redis ready failures per 60s.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not admitted; whether timeout stems from redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts causing inventory 503s, which propagate as ReadTimeouts to order and 502s at gateway checkout. Inventory metrics corroborate redis reserve_inventory failures. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout at inventory's redis dependency.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, CPU) to confirm redis-side saturation vs network timeout
Inventory logs (ev-...-r1-inventory-logs) excluded by budget; needed to confirm redis timeout root
